correctness.rationale: Graph and face membership are independently reconstructed on all 4096 masks, producing 1699 faces. An explicitly regenerated 847-pair matching covers all nonempty faces except exactly one vertex and three 5-cells; all 7980 covering incidences are exhaustively directed and an exact graph topological sort reaches all 1698 faces. Forman discrete Morse implies the integral wedge. Opposite-order 846-pair matching and mod-two boundary ranks are independent checks. Signed cellular Lefschetz traces are tested for every one of 48 cube automorphisms against the twisted natural 3D character, proving equality of rational finite-group representations.

value.rationale: The 3-cube is a natural first noncycle hypercube, giving a nontrivial complete topological base case for bounded-degree two-matchings. The integral 3-fold dimension-5 sphere wedge contrasts sharply with the known degree-one cube matching complex and captures real degree-relaxation topology. Determination of the full irreducible rational B3 symmetry representation is a structural refinement beyond finite counts and supports future studies of higher cubes. No unproved infinite-family or equivariant homotopy conclusion is needed for this exact natural object.
